supplemental.note: NASR cycle and supplemental evidence dates are distinct. Radar models are last documented types, not a claim of current equipment. NASA/JPL radar inventory is undated. Address geocodes are approximate.

completeness: Not a complete inventory. NASA/JPL supplies long-range radar site coordinates; FAA and NTSB supply selected terminal antenna positions. Many terminal radars and control facilities remain unlocated. Equipment inventories are dated, not live status. FAA-address Census geocodes are approximate. ARTCC boundaries show partial straight segments.
deduplication: AFF sites reconciled only by exact site name, type, state and source coordinates; shared center associations retained. Other cross-table duplicates have not been reconciled.
